subtopics.title: E-mail System Architecture
subtopics.summary: The three main components—user agents, mail servers, and the SMTP protocol—plus mailboxes, message queues, and how a message flows from sender to recipient's mailbox, including failure handling and retries.

subtopics.title: SMTP: Mail Transfer Protocol
subtopics.summary: How SMTP (RFC 5321) transfers messages between mail servers: client/server roles, TCP port 25, direct delivery, command/reply dialogue, and its restrictions and differences from HTTP.

subtopics.title: Mail Message Formats and MIME
subtopics.summary: The structure of an e-mail message with header lines (From:, To:, Subject:, Received:) and body, and MIME extensions that allow multimedia content in the body.

subtopics.title: Mail Access Protocols: POP3, IMAP, and HTTP
subtopics.summary: How recipients retrieve messages from their mail server: POP3 (download-and-delete vs. download-and-keep), IMAP (folders and server-side manipulation), and web-based e-mail over HTTP.
